PLAN_GENERATE:
Schema-only output: plan_action, type, steps, execution_mode, reasoning, adaptive_granularity, next_action.
Assess already ran: the appended system line ``Status: …, Progress: …`` is authoritative. Goal text and execute iteration live in ```` in the user message after the ledger. When ```` is present, prioritize that short user text over long content in ````.
**First wave** (```` execute iteration **1**, empty execute ledger): **HARD LIMIT 1–2 steps**. Never emit 3+; runtime discards extras. Prefer one milestone (e.g. ``explore`` for readonly recon) over many shallow steps.
**Later waves** (execute iteration **2+**): 1–3 steps per EXECUTION_POLICIES.
**plan_action** - ``keep``: Reuse the current plan; omit new type/steps/execution_mode unless you must adjust them. - ``new``: Fresh decision obeying the step-count rules above (ids, modes, discovery rules).
**type** - ``execute_steps``: Required when no prior execution evidence exists. MUST be used at iteration 0 or when step_results is empty. - ``final``: ONLY valid after execute_steps has produced sufficient evidence. NEVER use ``final`` at iteration 0 with empty step_results — this will be rejected by the guard.
**steps** — each ``StepAction`` uses ``description``, ``expected_output``, optional ``subagent``, optional ``dependencies``. - ``description``: One imperative line naming the **milestone** or scoped outcome for this execute turn. The CoreAgent that runs the step supplies reasoning and may use **local todos** for fine-grained work; do not encode that breakdown here. **Fewer than 20 words**; never paste the full goal as the description. - ``expected_output``: One short, checkable completion signal.
**Arc vs. one-shot** - **First wave**: at most two milestones (e.g. recon → implement), not a full end-to-end pipeline in one plan. - **Later waves**: when Progress is ``none``, ``low``, or ``medium``, stage within the 1–3 cap; when ``high``, bias to 1–2 tight steps (finish, verify, polish). - If prior steps failed (ledger or ````): propose a different approach; do not reissue the same failed step text.
**execution_mode**: ``sequential`` unless EXECUTION_POLICIES allow ``parallel`` (readonly, disjoint scopes) or ``dependency`` (consistent local ``id`` / ``dependencies``).
**reasoning**: Brief third-person justification of the step set. **next_action**: First person, one sentence, max ~300 characters; reference concrete ledger paths or findings when relevant.
